# Function grids

Generated by `tools/FunctionGrid gen`: for each math, logical, information and text function, the cross product of its argument domains
(typical values, boundaries, coercions, errors, array constants), thinned to at most 120 cases by a fixed stride.

* `FAMILY.fgrid` is the input of the Excel formula oracle (`office-oracle.sh run --formulas`).
* `FAMILY.expected.tsv` is `id`, formula, expected. The expected column stays empty until Excel has answered; `FunctionGrid fill DIR ANSWERS`
  copies the oracle's `*.fgrid.tsv` into it and `FunctionGrid compare DIR` lists every disagreement with this library.

Until then the grids are checked for one thing only: every formula parses and evaluates without an unexpected exception.
Cases that need cell contents (ranges holding text, blanks, errors) are not in this generated set.
RANDBETWEEN and RANDARRAY cases are volatile and have no stable expected value.
